meta.title: Notify subscribers when staff creates a record
meta.description: Query-first: find push subscriptions for an entity, then send.

flow.name: subscribersQuery
flow.comment: Example: subscriptions for entity_id = new record's scope

options.sql: SELECT user_uuid, entity_id, endpoint, p256dh, auth FROM push_subscriptions WHERE entity_id = :entityId AND active = 1

notes: Sends to all active subscription rows returned by the query (default).
Deactivate or delete rows when web-push returns expired (410) — check pushSend.results.
